nom: Origins Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Mask to Clear Pores

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the mask absorbs excess oil and reduces the look of large pores, though one found no notable difference in pores compared to other masks.
segments.dry: Reviewers describe it as drying if overused, but several with dry skin call it a gentler, non-stripping alternative to other clay masks as long as moisturizer follows.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including acne-prone combination skin, report clearer texture and fewer breakouts with regular use.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation and smoother, calmer skin, but others attribute a sudden onset of redness, bumps, burning and itching—some suspecting a formula change—to this product.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her forties describes it as a long-standing holy grail that keeps her skin smooth and renewed.

concerns.aging: A small number of long-time users, including one in her mid-forties, say the mask keeps skin looking smooth, renewed and youthful-glowing after regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it leaves skin hydrated, soft and not tight; others explicitly warn it is drying or note it is not a hydrating mask and recommend moisturizing right after.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers say it reduces redness and calms irritated skin quickly, including on active breakouts; however, a few describe the opposite reaction—new facial redness, bumpiness and swelling after use, with some suspecting a reformulation.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers with reactive or sensitive skin report no compromise to their skin's calm, tight, clean feel, but a couple describe burning, itching and a visible demarcation line where the mask was applied, suggesting a barrier reaction for them.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers use it successfully as a spot treatment that shrinks or dries out pimples and whiteheads overnight; one reviewer says it does not work on under-the-skin whiteheads/closed comedones.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers, including several long-term acne sufferers and parents of teenagers, report fewer breakouts, faster healing and reduced acne scarring with regular use; a minority instead report new or worsened breakouts, including cystic acne, especially after buying a newer tube.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently report the mask absorbs excess oil and controls shine, with several oily-skin users naming it their most effective oil-control mask.

aspects.libelle: Skin feels clean and smooth after rinsing
Tightening, slightly drying sensation while drying
Price increase and reduced package size
Good value, product lasts many uses

extraits.texte: I've used this product for years and after a one year hiatus, I just bought a new tube. After using it, my face was burning, red, and very very bumpy. The itchiness has stopped after a few days but my skin is still just as bumpy for almost a week now. I used to use this product 3/4 times a week no problem and raved about how good it was. What happened?

Ive used bottles of this throughout my mask wearing and it helped control my mask acne. It was a MIRACLE. Recently I ran out of it and my face started breaking out again so I bought a new bottle. Unfortunately my cystic mask acne is not going away now. The product seems to go on thinner than it used to and it dries quicker. So I wonder if there was possibly a change in the product.

extraits.titre: The only clay mask that works for me
extraits.texte: I've used this mask on and off for over 10 years. I shop around for others sometimes because this one is kind of expensive. Lately I've been trying others that have a similar price point though and even they can't compare. I have super oily skin and large pores and this mask is the best thing short of a professional chemical peel that I've found to keep my pores clear. I've tried so many other hyped up clay masks and none of them do much of anything but with this one I can see a difference immediately after washing it off. I leave it on for as long as I can stand it, sometime even overnight which maybe is not recommended but for me it works. I'm going to stop wasting my money on other clay masks and just stick with this one from now on even if the price tag is a bit painful.

I am in my mid twenties and have struggled with acne for about 15 years or so. Additionally, I have large pores, uneveness, redness, oily, sensitive skin, just about everything you can put into a skin type. I've tried every solution under the sun, serums, creams, spot treatments, you name it, and NOTHING has cleared my skin more than this product. I bought it as a fun Valentine's spa date night idea and it's genuinely become a holy grail staple in my skincare routine (which is not extensive btw, I use the mask 1-2 times/week and pair with my go to moisturizer. simple but effective!) I leave the mask on for 15-20 min and gently wipe off with a slightly damp washcloth and immediately can tell the difference. My skin glows, my pores feel tight and clean. The following morning I'll notice my breakouts healing. It's even helped with toning down redness and existing acne scars. I can't say enough good things about this product - I've been really insecure about my skin for quite some time, especially as a lady in her mid twenties still struggling with acne. In just 2 weeks, this product has made a noticeable difference on my skin and my confidence is through the roof. Highly, highly recommend. If you are struggling with the price, know that a little goes a long way, and once a week is still enough for a noticeable difference!

I discovered this mask when I was about 17, and at 43 it's still the only mask I will ever use. I have combination skin, which is acne prone. EVERYTHING makes me break out. This mask makes my skin glow and does not make me break out. Using it about twice a month keeps my skin looking smooth and renewed. Big love for this product!

I love this scrub! I have very sensitive skin and only recently did I start scrubbinh my face 1x a week, my biggest concern was preventing breakouts which this product does. What I didn't expect is how smooth and flawless my nose would look! 10/10 product and very easy to apply, I love the sensation when it dries out as well. So far it has never made my face irritated so I am very very happy!
If you don't want to splurge on the glamglow mask, this mask is the perfect, dry skin friendly, alternative. I have travel size (minis) with me at all times when I travel.
